title: Kuratidzwa Kweunyengeri
intro: Chisungo cheukama chakaedzwa negodo guru. Hurongwa hwepachivande hwakarongwa, huchitanga zviitiko zvakawanda zvaizotora makore akawanda zvichiyambuka daro refu. Zviito zveboka iri zvakakonzera kuparadzana kukuru nekusuwa, asi nyaya yacho haina kugumira ipapo. Inyaya yekunyengera, kuzvidemba, uye kuzarurwa kwehurongwa hwaMwari. Unogona here kutsanangura kuti vanhu ava vane sarudzo dzakafanana nedzezvizvarwa nezvizvarwa?
clues: Takakundwa negodo nekuda kwerudo rwakaratidzwa kune mumwe wedu.
Negodo redu, takarangana pamwe chete ndokukanda munin'ina wedu murima retsime.
Kuti tivanze zvatakaita, takapa baba vedu nguo, yakasvibiswa neropa renhema.
Makore akazotevera, nzara huru yakatimanikidza kuenda kuIjipiti tichinotsvaga zvekudya.
Ikoko, takaenda pamberi pegavhuna ane simba, uyo, tisingazive, ndiye mukoma kana munun'una watakanga tatadzira.
Muedzo wedu wekupedzisira waive wekuunza munin'ina wedu mudiki, Binyamin, izvo zvakaita kuti nhoroondo yedu yekare izivikanwe uye baba vedu vari Muporofita Ya'qub.
